Next to him, a young woman with long brown hair and straight bangs, wearing a beige hoodie, looks at the phone screen. The phone screen displays a picture-in-picture video of another couple making faces in a mirror. (2) The couple in the foreground interacts; the woman looks at the man and smiles, while the man gestures slightly with the phone he is holding. The background features a plain wall with a horizontal air vent. (3) The scene cuts to an outdoor street during daylight. The couple is standing in front of a large, circular convex traffic mirror with an orange frame. The man holds his phone up to record their reflection. He reaches his hand toward the mirror surface, and the woman mimics a biting motion with her mouth open near the reflection of his hand. Background objects include parked cars and residential buildings under a clear sky.
